rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §6 re-proposes three changes whose machinery already exists in the tree (the source-to-COCOS angle-factor retirement, the SELENE converter's tangential-axis write, and the catalogue-to-signal-map observation reader), so its search is stale against the revision it would extend.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each new layer (`measure_convention` generalising the DIII-D entry, the description-route probe-angle supplier) extends an existing owner with a stated reason rather than paralleling it; the two readers that produce `ShotSignObservation` share one kernel, and the EQDB additions extend `RemoteEddbExtractor`/`eddb.py` with helpers extracted from `write_channel` rather than a second store.
